source_title: Schools Should Make Human Beings, Not Workers
summary: This March 11, 2015 WISE panel gives an early education-pressure source: school is framed as a choice between producing workers and forming human beings whose basic needs include learning, love, and creation, with teacher authority rebuilt through trust, design, and contextual judgment.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Schools must choose whether they produce workers or human beings, and that choice decides whether creativity appears as a threat or as a basic human need.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The panel gives an early, explicit statement of the education soul-game boundary: the school game is not neutral information delivery, but a formation machine that can train compliance, fear, or full human agency.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Obedience can generate discipline, but trust generates autonomy, and autonomy generates creativity.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing trust lens point is grounded in child-world reliability before school; this source supplies a classroom-professional counterpart where trust is the condition that lets teacher and student autonomy become creative rather than chaotic.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Teachers should become designers and contextual researchers rather than rule-followers, while students and teachers respond together to real social need.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source predates the later Jiang creativity interview but already carries the anti-authority school mechanism in professional form: evidence, design, real problems, and contextual judgment replace passive compliance.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this 2015 WISE panel as an early dated education formulation before the 2020 COVID-schooling clips and the 2026 creativity interview: the core fork is already workers versus human beings, with learning, love, and creation named as basic human needs.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns this chronology because the active mechanism is school purpose and soul formation. Human Heart owns the broader anthropology of love, trust, and creativity only when the source is testing civilization or relation directly rather than the school form.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add a teacher-agency mechanism: creativity cannot be produced by ring-bound rules, tips, or abandoned improvisation; teachers need trust, evidence, peer feedback, coaching, teaching teams, and design authority to become authors of pedagogy.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Keep this inside Education unless later sources make teacher-as-designer a recurring public concept. Bureaucracy would own the ring-bound-rule pathology only if the active mechanism becomes institutional self-protection rather than school formation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Mention only as secondary support if a later heart pass needs the education-adjacent formulation that human beings need to learn, love, and create as fundamentally as food, water, and shelter.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The sentence is anthropological, but the source's work is a school-design argument. Do not pull it into Human Heart in a way that erases the education boundary.

new_lens_seeds.title: Teacher As Pedagogy Designer
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A school becomes creative when teachers are trusted and scaffolded as designers of curriculum, assessment, relationships, and learning experiences, instead of being treated as delivery workers who follow scripts or consume tips.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can explain future education sources wherever Jiang distinguishes living teacher judgment from compliance, training, rule-following, or tool delivery, but this panel alone is not enough for a public concept separate from Education As A Soul Game.

new_lens_seeds.title: Trust Autonomy Creativity Chain
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Obedience can create discipline, but trust creates autonomy, and autonomy creates the conditions for creativity; the creative school therefore needs safety nets that make autonomy usable instead of merely removing control.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The chain may become a durable education mechanism if it recurs beyond this short panel, especially alongside Jiang's later trust, wellbeing, and teacher-redundancy sources.

chronology_notes.note: On 2015-03-11, this WISE panel already states the worker-versus-human-being education fork and links creativity to learning, love, and creation before the later 2020 COVID education stress tests and the 2026 creativity interview.

The source predates Jiang's later explicit creativity-as-scientific-process formulation, but it already gives a professional version of the same anti-compliance pressure: teachers and students must respond to real need through design, evidence, and contextual judgment.
